youtube.title: Why American Houses Are Wood, Not Brick (Blame a Nail and a Fire)
youtube.description: Knock on an American wall and it sounds hollow. Knock on one in London and you hit brick. Why? America had about a billion acres of forest while England was running out of trees, machine-made nails got roughly 90% cheaper, and the 1871 Chicago fire didn't end wooden houses: workers rioted to keep building them. Today about nine in ten new US homes are wood framed. The Hidden Why: the true story behind the things you use every day. #TheHiddenWhy #facts #explained
